name: Confluence
description: Confluence is Atlassian's team workspace for documentation, meeting notes, and internal knowledge shared across an organization.
best_for: Positioned as a single source of truth for cross-functional and enterprise teams across departments like software development, HR, marketing, and product management.
features: Teamwork Graph connecting people, work, and goals
Multiple content types: docs, whiteboards, databases, slides, video
Integrations with Jira, Figma, GitHub, Google Drive, Microsoft Teams

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: A flexible workspace combining documents, databases, project boards, and team knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller teams wanting a lighter-weight, faster setup

alternatives.name: Coda
alternatives.description: A collaborative document platform that combines text, tables, formulas, and app-like workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams building custom internal tools on top of docs

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: A project-management platform with tasks, dashboards, documents, and workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want documentation and project tracking in one place
